summary: GRI Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to furnish a press release announcing first-quarter 2026 financial results and a corporate update, including Phase 2a data for GRI-0621 in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure and business progress report, not a special-situation event. No transaction, shareholder action, or structural change is described. The company remains listed on Nasdaq. This is an ordinary current report with no deal terms or strategic event to classify.
